easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Glorious Protector, and Changeling Berserker must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Berserker for its mana cost.
When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
